# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1][cov]. By taking part, you
agree to uphold it.

To report unacceptable behaviour, contact the maintainers through GitHub.
Reports are kept confidential, and the maintainers respect the reporter's
privacy.

The full text is at <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>.

[cov]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/
